title: CompTIA Network+
overview: The CompTIA Network+ certification course provides a thorough understanding of networking concepts and technologies. It is designed for individuals aiming to validate their knowledge and skills in network management, installation, and troubleshooting. The course covers essential networking topics and prepares participants for the Network+ (N10-008) certification exam.
audience: Individuals seeking to start a career in network management.
Entry-level network engineers and support staff.
Students and learners aiming for foundational network knowledge.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanations of networking concepts and technologies.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for configuring and troubleshooting network devices.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to apply networking knowledge and skills.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore network challenges and best practices.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a comprehensive understanding of networking principles and technologies.
To develop practical skills in network installation, configuration, and troubleshooting.
To prepare participants for the CompTIA Network+ certification exam.
To familiarize participants with real-world network scenarios and solutions.

items.text: Understanding Network Basics (OSI Model, TCP/IP Model)
Identifying Network Devices and Their Functions (Routers, Switches, Hubs)
Understanding Cabling and Connectors (Ethernet, Fiber Optic)
Configuring IP Addresses and Subnet Masks
Understanding Network Security Concepts and Threats
Managing Network Performance and Monitoring Tools
Managing Network Access and User Accounts
Exploring Trends in Networking Technology (SDN, Cloud Networking)
Understanding Internet of Things (IoT) and Its Impact on Networks
Evaluating the Impact of Emerging Technologies on Network Design
